note: Congregations come from several directories (Devout, PewSearch, ChurchFinder, Christianity.com), the Wikipedia list of Diocese of Manchester parishes and a 2021 Rivier University worship list. Service times are shown only where an opened page gave them; most come from the congregation's own site, and Catholic Sunday times come from a third-party Mass directory. The Nashua Area Interfaith Council (founded as the Nashua Council of Churches in the 1940s) links many of these congregations. No Quaker meeting or Sikh gurdwara in Nashua was found. No public faith events for November or December 2026 were found on pages that could be opened.
